Search / recall / prompt injection never cross that boundary — prompt injection is re"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"gistered at **agent scope**, so each session's system prompt only ever shows its own task's memories"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart the web UI (or reboot the profile), then in a session:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. `memory_bind_task` — e.g. `taskId: "my-app"` (optional `title`)
2. `memory_remember` — `key: "sta"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ck"`, `content: "Node 22 + Postgres"`, optionally `pinned: true`

4. `memory_current_task` — confirm which vault this session is on"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| `memory_bind_task` | Bind this session to a task vault |
| `memory_current_task` | Show the sessio"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"n's current vault (binding or default) |
| `memory_remember` | Upsert a fact by `key` (optional tags"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" / pin / task override) |
| `memory_recall` | Exact-key read |
| `memory_search` | Keyword search (E"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"N + 中文 bigrams); empty query lists recent/pinned |
| `memory_forget` | Delete one key |
| `memory_li"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"st_tasks` | List vaults |
| `memory_clear_task` | Wipe one vault (`confirm: true` required) |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Never store secrets in memory entries."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install / verify / disable"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"After install or remove, restart `dsh web` (or reboot the profile) so the Cordis layer reloads."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Vault files under `~/.dsh/storages/task-memory/` are **not** deleted on uninstall — back up or delet"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"e them yourself if needed."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Local develop (without installing)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Link a checkout while developing:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"If you run DSH from a source checkout:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Update the absolute path in `cordis.dev.yml` so it points at this checkout’s built `lib/index.js`."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`cordis.patch.yml` defaults:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Optional `storageRoot` overrides `~/.dsh/storages/task-memory`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Storage & reliability"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Each file:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Files are plain JSON — safe to hand-edit or back up
- Writes go through **tmp file + atomic rename"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"**, so readers always see a consistent snapshot
- Mutations for the same task (including `memory_bin"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"d_task` title updates, `save`, and `update`) are **serialized** in-process (per-task lock); concurre"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"nt agents cannot lose updates. Prefer `update` over `load` → mutate → `save` for read-modify-write
-"},{"id":"p37s5","text":" Pinned entries are **never evicted**; when a full vault has nothing removable but pinned entries, *"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"*new keys** are rejected with a clear error instead of silently dropping the just-written fact, whil"},{"id":"p37s7","text":"e upserts of existing keys are never blocked by capacity (they still shrink best-effort)
- On startu"},{"id":"p37s8","text":"p, stale `*.tmp` files from crashed writes are cleaned up (only those older than 1h, so another proc"},{"id":"p37s9","text":"ess's live write is never touched)"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Model experience"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"When `injectPrompt` is true, the plugin injects a short memory block into the **current agent sessio"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"n's** system prompt:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- Only the vault bound to that session (or the cwd-derived default)
- Prefer pinned entries, then re"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"cent ones, up to `injectLimit` / char budgets
- Other sessions and other tasks never appear in this "},{"id":"p40s3","text":"ones, up to `injectLimit` / char budgets
- Other sessions and other tasks never appear in this block"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"Tools remain available for explicit recall/search beyond what fits in the prompt."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"- Host-only bundle: no Web UI for browsing vaults yet (see roadmap)
- Keyword search is lexical (EN "},{"id":"p43s2","text":"tokens + 中文 bigrams), not embeddings / vector search
- Isolation is per **task id** within this plug"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"in — it does not sandbox the rest of DSH
- Catalog listing on dsh.pub is an automated contract check"},{"id":"p43s4","text":", not a security audit
